title: MoveActorPrimitive
description: Spatial migration primitive that updates an actor's current district and expends travel time and fatigue.

step_id.description: Unique identifier for this pipeline step.

actor.description: Entity token to relocate (e.g. ORDER_ACTOR, INITIATOR, or specific operative ID).

destination.description: Target district identifier or dynamic symbol (e.g. PARAM.target_node_id).

travel_time.description: Transit time in shift minutes consumed by the relocation.

travel_fatigue.description: Physical fatigue incurred by the actor during transit.

error_code.description: Failure code if route is blocked or inaccessible (e.g. ROUTE_UNREACHABLE).

next_step.description: ID of next step on completion, or null to terminate pipeline.
